title: DiagnosisArena Dataset Construction and Clinical Diagnostic Evaluation

nodes.label:
Top-Tier Medical Journal Corpus
4,175 Clinical Case Reports Sourced from 10 Premier Journals
Covers Complex Diagnostic Challenges across 28 Medical Specialties

Claude 3.5 Sonnet Clinical Segmentation
Decouples Initial Patient Presentation from Confirmatory Outcomes
Structures Cases into 4 Fields (Presentation, Labs, Differential, Gold)

Zero Diagnostic Information Leakage?
Strict Boundary Verification Ensuring Biopsies & Therapies Are Omitted
Prevents Pre-Diagnostic Clues from Contaminating the Patient Record

Diagnostic Leakage Discard Sink
Discards Reports Where Treatment Explicitly Reveals the Underlying Disease
Guarantees Strict Realistic Bedside Diagnostic Blindness

Multi-Model Hardness Triaging
3 Foundation LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini) x 2 Attempts
Identifies Readily Solvable vs Challenging Clinical Scenarios

Challenging & Unanimously AI-Approved?
Filters Out Trivial Cases Solved Effortlessly by Foundation Models
Retains 1,783 High-Difficulty Diagnostic Puzzles for Deep Reasoning

Trivial Case Discard Sink
Eliminates Overly Common or Textbook-Standard Clinical Presentations
Focuses Benchmark on Challenging, Atypical, and Rare Disease Presentations

Physician Expert Panel Consensus Gate
Senior Licensed Clinicians Validate Medical Completeness and Clarity
Confirms Solvability via DeepSeek-R1 (8 Runs) and Finalizes 1,113 Cases

DiagnosisArena Official Frozen Benchmark
1,113 Validated Clinical Diagnostic Cases (915 Public Split)
Standardized Diagnostic Ground Truth Mapped to ICD-10 / SNOMED-CT

Patient History & Workup Prompting
Injects Chronological Case History, Vitals, Physical Exam & Lab Panels
Configurable in Open-Ended Generation or 4-Option Multiple Choice Format

Autoregressive Diagnostic Inference
Clinical AI Generates Differential Diagnosis Ranked by Likelihood
Greedy Decoding (T=0) with Boxed Top-k Diagnostic Nominations

Medical Entity Extraction & UMLS Normalization
Parses Model Diagnostic Output via MedCAT & Synonym Regular Expressions
Normalizes Text Candidates to Unified UMLS Concept Unique Identifiers

Predicted Diagnosis Matches Gold Target?
Semantic Equivalence Check Against Gold Standard Pathological Diagnosis
Evaluates Top-1 Prediction and Top-k Differential Inclusion

Misdiagnosis / False Negative Sink
Catalogues Missed Diagnoses, Premature Closure, and Hallucinated Conditions
Categorized by Organ System, Clinical Rarity, and Diagnostic Severity

Top-k Diagnostic Credit Calculation
Assigns Top-1 Exact Hit, Top-3 Inclusion, and Top-5 Coverage Scores
Analyzes Diagnostic Calibration and Clinical Confidence Scores
